name: voice-notes help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:voice-notes. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.

entries.title: Read again
entries.text: Reads again. Part of Voice notes.

entries.title: Listen for voice notes
entries.text: Turns “Listen for voice notes” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Voice notes.
